analysis.summary: Sonam Limited reported its financial performance for the first half of FY 2026-27, highlighting a substantial increase in revenue from operations to ₹19,596.41 lakhs and a PAT of ₹675.73 lakhs. The company operates a manufacturing facility in Morbi, Gujarat, with an installed capacity of 72 lakhs p.a. for clocks and 240 lakhs p.a. for clock movements. Management emphasized ongoing commitments to product innovation, operational efficiency, and strengthening stakeholder relationships.

guidance.claim: Management has given full-year guidance of 25% to 30% growth.
guidance.quote: you have given the guidance that full-year guidance will be 25% to 30% growth.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue for the next quarter to be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.
guidance.quote: For the next quarter we hope that revenue will be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced strong operational performance and deadly demand across its product portfolio during the first quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: The 1st Quarter of FY’27 has been an increasing start to the financial year, reflecting strong operational performance, deadly demand across our product portfolio and our continuing commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains highly optimistic about opportunities over the next four to five years.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we remain highly optimistic about the opportunities before us over the next four to five years.

demand_outlook.claim: Export demand has been affected due to logistic problems.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes. Export demand has been affected.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin for H1 FY27 was 6.07% compared to 7.73% in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA margin stood at 6.07%, compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49%, reflecting our continued focus on operation efficiency, disciplined cost management and sustainable profitability.

margins_costs.claim: Margin side is fluctuating because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing.
margins_costs.quote: Margin side is fluctuating because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing. So, the margin is fluctuating a bit.
Yes, raw material cost has increased.

orders_capacity.claim: Current manufacturing capacity utilization is 60% to 70%.
Capacity utilization is reported on a quarter-to-quarter basis.

capital_allocation.claim: There are no requirements for additional borrowings for now.
Debtors for 2024-25 were Rs. 10 crore and for 2025-26 were Rs. 6.73 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: 2024-25 debtors is Rs. 10 crore and 2025-26, debtors is only Rs. 6.73 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.
risks_headwinds.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

risks_headwinds.claim: Freight cost has increased due to the war scenario.
risks_headwinds.quote: Due to this war scenario, the freight cost has increased.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects that the 25% to 30% full-year growth will be sustained.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, we hope that 25% to 30% growth will be sustained.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to sell clocks in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 and develop such items in the year 2027-28.
management_commitments.quote: So, our segment, our market planning is we will sell clock in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 and develop such items in this year, 2027-28.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to check return rates and damages on online platforms for two to three months during a trial phase before starting in full force.
management_commitments.quote: So, that is why we have started a trial phase. We will check for two, three months that how much goods are returned to us and how much damage we are facing. After that, we will start in full force.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
